rules: Read BASE_CONTEXT.md + PROJECT_CONTEXT.md at the start of every session
Read the relevant contract file before touching any endpoint, event, or schema
Update API_CONTRACTS.md when any route or response shape changes
Update WS_PROTOCOL.md when any Socket.IO event changes
Update SCHEMA_STATE.md when any Prisma model or Redis key changes
Update PORTAL_CAPABILITIES.md backend column when feature status changes
Append to PROJECT_CONTEXT.md file change log after every change
Append to SESSION_LOG.md before ending every session
Never contradict arch_plan_raw.txt without flagging it explicitly
